For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat
but it withereth the grass
and the flower thereof falleth
and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth : so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways .
For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls
and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.
For when the sun comes up with its burning heat
the grass gets dry and the grace of its form is gone with the falling flower; so the man of wealth comes to nothing in his ways.
